note: Reference data compiled by research, not by the app. Dupe claims are community consensus and are attributed to a source, never stated as manufacturer fact. Prices are a snapshot on checkedAt and go stale.

perfumes.name: Khamrah
perfumes.review: A cinnamon-cardamom-date opening over a creamy vanilla-tonka heart, turning praline-sweet in the dry-down. Reviewers rate performance well above its price: roughly 8-10 hours with strong projection, enough that over-applying is the usual warning. Opinion splits on quality - some call it the best under $50, others find it synthetic or sharp on first spray, and on warmer skin it tips further into dessert territory.

perfumes.name: Asad
perfumes.review: A spiced oriental built on oud, saffron and amber. Frequently named the strongest masculine pick in the line, with heavy projection for the first couple of hours before it settles closer to the skin.

perfumes.name: Yara

dupeOf.name: Van Cleef and Arpels Orchidee Vanille

perfumes.review: A floral oriental of rose, musk and amber. Usually recommended as the easiest entry point in the line because it reads as inoffensive in most settings.

perfumes.name: Fakhar

dupeOf.confidence: disputed - one list names Pegasus, another argues it is an original composition rather than a clone

perfumes.review: A gourmand-floral: bright fruit up top over a creamy, sweet woody base.

dupeOf.name: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume

perfumes.name: Bade'e Al Oud Honor and Glory

perfumes.name: Khamrah Dukhan
perfumes.review: The smokier flanker to Khamrah: it keeps the cinnamon-date sweetness but lays incense and smoke over the top.

dupeOf.name: Creed Aventus
dupeOf.confidence: commonly cited - community comparisons place it closer to Aventus than to Nishane Hacivat

perfumes.name: 9pm
perfumes.review: A sweet, faintly bubblegum-leaning crowd-pleaser, grouped by reviewers with Invictus and Rasasi Hawas for that quality. How well it reads depends noticeably on skin chemistry.

perfumes.name: Turathi Blue
perfumes.review: Sharp grapefruit with ambroxan over clean musk and fresh woods - bright and warm-weather leaning.

perfumes.name: Hawas for Him
perfumes.review: An aquatic-sweet marine profile; reviewers group its sweetness with Invictus and Afnan 9pm.

perfumes.name: Hawas Chrome
perfumes.review: Fruity-amber: peach, yellow fruit and orange up top over mango, passion fruit, amber, vanilla and musk.

perfumes.name: Hawas Black

dupeOf.name: Nishane Hacivat
dupeOf.confidence: commonly cited, with a caveat - owners of both call it the closest Hacivat alternative they have tried, but not a 1:1 match: Hacivat leans more citrus, Hawas Black harder on oakmoss

perfumes.review: Citrus opening of bergamot and grapefruit over a smoky pineapple heart, drying down woody with a pronounced oakmoss streak. Longevity is the headline: most reviewers report 7-10 hours with moderate, well-behaved sillage rather than a room-filler. Commonly called a steal at the price, and rated as projecting and lasting better than several rivals in its bracket.

perfumes.name: Gentleman Society
perfumes.review: Sage and cardamom over a double dose of vetiver - Haitian and Madagascan - with French narcissus, settling into palo santo, cedar and vanilla. The opening is the part everyone agrees on; reviewers differ sharply after that, some getting 7-8 hours of decent performance, others finding it collapses within the hour and turns synthetic and cloying in the dry-down. Sillage is moderate rather than loud.

perfumes.name: Ferragamo Red Leather
perfumes.review: Spicy-citrus opening of ginger, bergamot and mandarin over orris, rosemary and jasmine, landing on sandalwood, leather and vetiver. Longevity is the contested point: some reviewers get 7-10 hours and call the projection powerful, others find it goes close to the skin inside 3-4 hours and settles into a soft herbal sweetness. Widely described as good value rather than a statement buy.

perfumes.name: Sunrise on the Red Sand Dunes

dupeOf.name: Louis Vuitton L'Immensite
dupeOf.confidence: disputed - commonly sold as an Imagination dupe, but reviewers who own both argue it is 80-90 percent L'Immensite and not Imagination at all

perfumes.review: Citrus-fresh: mandarin, ginger and bergamot over orange blossom and blackcurrant on an amber base. Performance is the common complaint - around 5-6 hours and little projection unless oversprayed, with the notes blurring together as it drops to a skin scent. Judged a strong buy for the money rather than a strong fragrance. Note there is also a 2024 Intense version; this entry is the original.

perfumes.name: Aghori
perfumes.review: Smoked oud, tobacco and black pepper opening into cannabis, myrrh, leather and jasmine, resting on patchouli, sandalwood and amber. Earthy, smoky and animalic, and not a light or generic wear - reviewers place it firmly in evening and occasion territory. Longevity is its strength at a reported 8-10 hours on skin and longer on cloth. An Extrait at 38 percent concentration, which is where the performance comes from.
